description: List keywords (recipe tags). Optional: query (name filter, or similarity ranking if fuzzy search is on), root (parent id, 0 for top-level), tree (id, with its descendants), root_tree, random, limit. root, tree and root_tree ignore query, random, limit and updated_at.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

limit.description: Maximum number of keywords, as a string, e.g. "10".

query.description: Name filter, or similarity ranking when Tandoor fuzzy search is on.

random.description: String. Any non-empty value shuffles the order, even "false".

root.description: Parent keyword ID; lists its direct children. 0 lists top-level keywords.

root_tree.description: Keyword ID; lists the whole tree that keyword belongs to.

tree.description: Keyword ID; lists that keyword and all its descendants.

updated_at.description: ISO datetime; only keywords updated at or after it.

name: list_keywords
title: List keywords
